description: NEMAR launcher. Fetches a code bundle, stages datasets, runs the entry in a contained image and uploads the results through NEMAR's own routes. Every job is owned by NEMAR.

jobAttributes.description: One launch of the nemar-launch zip. The execution system, queue and resources are set when the job is submitted; the defaults below are the smallest job that fits every queue.

envVariables.description: The launch specification: base64url of the launch specification JSON text, at most 87,382 characters, supplied by NEMAR for each job. It holds the job's upload token.
The directory on the node that holds the image files, each named by its digest (64 hex digits, then .sif). Fixed: a job request cannot point the launcher at another directory.
The root of NEMAR's own copy of datasets on the node, laid out as <root>/<dataset id>/<version>/. Fixed. A directory that does not exist is the same as no local copy: the launcher downloads.

Empty here: the interpreter the entry script uses is the first Python 3.9 or newer on the host. If the host needs a named one, the operator registers a new version that sets it. Declared and fixed so that a job request cannot set one.

A node-local directory for the launcher's scratch space (code, datasets and the container's /tmp). Fixed, and never inside the archived output directory. The scheduler's own SLURM_TMPDIR, when set, takes precedence.
